التحمت (form VIII)

# اِلْتَحَمْتَ (iltaḥamta) /il.ta.ħam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# اِلْتَحَمْتِ (iltaḥamti) /il.ta.ħam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# اِلْتَحَمَتْ (iltaḥamat) /il.ta.ħa.mat/: third-perso
